items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-48358, CVSS 10.0), unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6), privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Several critical issues, such as CVE-2026-47988 and CVE-2026-47984, require no authentication to exploit.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento and Adobe Commerce, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released version 1.11.12 to patch this flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including Stored Cross-site Scripting (CVE-2026-34686, CVSS 8.7) leading to arbitrary code execution, and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653, CVSS 8.7) allowing arbitrary file system writes. Successful exploitation could also lead to application denial-of-service and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec identified 'PolyShell', a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, bypassing validation and potentially leading to remote code execution. While Magento 2.4.9 contains a fix, older supported versions require mitigation.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute arbitrary code, and access sensitive files. Specific issues include Stored XSS (CVE-2026-21290, CVSS 8.7) and Server-Side Request Forgery (CVE-2026-21293).
